title: Questor external event projection (v1)
description: Single source of truth for the external event envelope (HARD C6/C15; design/02). Additive-only: new `type` values and optional `data` fields are allowed; existing semantics must not change. Cross-language TS types are codegen'd from this file in P7; CI --check prevents drift against questor.contracts.events.EventType.

v.description: Wire-contract version; bump only on breaking change.

data.description: Type-specific payload; exact fields are draft until P1 (C11). Unknown members are allowed and ignored by consumers (C6).
